title: Release quest-cli 0.3.2
description: Release 0.3.2, carrying QCLI-220 (task view/list path field) and QCLI-223 (P0 fix: dependency/parentId resolution across all task locations) to npm. User-authorized 2026-09-04 (patch bump + full publish ceremony, batched decision per opum-agent orchestrator instruction that publishing is irreversible/outward-facing). Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, optionalDependencies, and the conformance fixture bumped to 0.3.2 and committed together with freshly-built (Bun 1.3.14) platform packages so check:packages passes on first CI attempt
v0.3.2 tag pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it; native-execution receipt downloaded and bun run receipt:require passes
release.yml dispatched with publish=false (dry run) then publish=true against v0.3.2, gated on the receipt
Post-publish clean-install smoke (version, manifest, task op) passes against the published registry artifacts
bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the six published platform tarballs
Release notes state this fixed one write-locked workspace (quest-cli's own) and removed a latent trap the rest of the fleet had not yet hit, not a live fleet-wide outage
